command.isekai_mahou.encounter.failed: Failed: unknown kind (travellers, wounded, fairy_ring), not in the Overworld, or no free ground nearby.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.kid.1: When I grow up I'll be an adventurer like you!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.kid.2: Have you ever seen a real dragon?
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.kid.3: My mum said not to talk to strangers... but you look nice.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.kid.4: Show me a spell? Just one, please!
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.kid.5: The guard can't catch me, I'm the fastest!
encounter.isekai_mahou.fairy.blessing: The fairies dance around you — Fairy Blessing!
encounter.isekai_mahou.pilgrims.greet.0: May the heavens guide your steps. We're on pilgrimage to the city.
encounter.isekai_mahou.pilgrims.greet.1: Hello! We've been walking for days... good thing the road has kind folk.
encounter.isekai_mahou.pilgrims.greet.2: Did you hear the song? Our bard never stops!
Fair winds, traveller! Is the road quiet? Have a look at my wares.
Ah, a friendly face. We're heading to town — care to trade first?
Kingdom caravan! Road prices, today only.
encounter.isekai_mahou.wounded.help.0: Hey... you there... please, help me...
encounter.isekai_mahou.wounded.help.1: I was attacked on the road... I can't walk...
encounter.isekai_mahou.wounded.help.2: Some food... or a potion... anything...
encounter.isekai_mahou.wounded.need: Food or a potion... please. (Use it on me.)
encounter.isekai_mahou.wounded.reward: %s thanks you and gives you some coins.
encounter.isekai_mahou.wounded.rumor: %1$s gives you some coins and warns: "Beware of %2$s, about %3$s blocks to the %4$s. That's where they got me."
encounter.isekai_mahou.wounded.thanks.0: Thank you! You saved my life.
encounter.isekai_mahou.wounded.thanks.1: May the gods repay you, adventurer.
hint.isekai_mahou.encounter.fairy_ring: A glow in the grass nearby... a fairy ring. Stand inside it for a few seconds.
hint.isekai_mahou.encounter.wounded: Someone wounded on the road: use food or a potion on them.
hint.isekai_mahou.world_events.star_show: Star Shower: stay outdoors and follow the trails of light — fragments fall near you.
isekai_mahou.configuration.worldLife.too: Fireflies on warm nights, leaves falling from the canopy, pollen over meadows, mana motes in magic biomes and shooting stars. Light; off on the LOW graphics preset.
world_event.isekai_mahou.star_shower.sta: Shooting stars streak across the sky tonight. Some reach the ground...
